name: Inkscape
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: Command-line actions export and convert SVG and other vector source to PNG, PDF and plain SVG
summary: Open-source vector editor. The inkscape CLI runs actions on a document, converts between SVG, PDF, EPS and PNG, exports by object id or area at a given DPI, and strips to plain SVG. Strength is faithful handling of designer-authored Inkscape SVG, including text-to-path, before it enters VCR. It is not an animation tool.
use_when: Designer SVG needs text converted to paths or objects exported by id
Over resvg when Inkscape-specific features must render as authored
Over svgo when you must edit objects by action, not just minify
Converting PDF or EPS artwork into SVG for animation
avoid_when: Plain SVG to PNG at scale: resvg is faster and lighter
Motion of any kind: GSAP, Synfig or Blender
notes: 2026-10-26: Official 1.4 and 1.4.1 platform pages list an arm64 dmg; Homebrew cask currently reports 1.4.4. Startup time per invocation is not measured; use --shell or actions for batches.

assessment.rationale: 1.4.4 tagged 2026-05-05 (1.4.3 in December 2025); official platform pages list a macOS arm64 dmg and the cask is available. CLI actions and export are documented.
